channel.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell updates
channel.description: Release updates for the self-hosted Ring-to-AirPlay custom chime bridge.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.20
item.description: Version 0.2.20 updates the Ring push receiver so expired FCM installations and stalled push connections recover automatically.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.19
item.description: Version 0.2.19 logs every received Ring push notification to make missing doorbell events traceable.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.18
item.description: Version 0.2.18 surrounds the chime with silence so HomePods no longer drop it while AirPlay is still buffering.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.17
item.description: Version 0.2.17 pins an OwnTone build containing the upstream HomePod OS 27 AirPlay fix while retaining verified receiver activation.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.16
item.description: Version 0.2.16 restores reliable HomePod playback by using AirPlay 1 for the configured Apple speakers and verifying receiver activation before playing the chime.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.15
item.description: Version 0.2.15 recovers from an invalid persisted Ring token by safely trying a newly configured Runtipi token while preserving Ring's automatic token rotation.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.14
item.description: Version 0.2.14 skips AirPlay receivers that currently require authorization, so one unavailable device can no longer prevent playback on ready HomePods.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.13
item.description: Version 0.2.13 fixes Ring push notification decryption when Web Push headers contain additional parameters, preventing affected doorbell events from being dropped.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.12
item.description: Version 0.2.12 adds the public project website, bilingual marketing content, and support links alongside the existing Ring-to-AirPlay bridge.
